title: habenaria ciliaris var. holopetala
intro: Habenaria ciliaris var. holopetala, commonly known as the Indian orchid, is a plant species belonging to the orchid family (Orchidaceae). It is valued for its medicinal properties, which include health benefits such as antiseptic and anti-inflammatory properties, helping to soothe wounds, reduce pain, and alleviate fever. The therapeutic actions of this plant include its use as a treatment for respiratory issues, gastrointestinal problems, and skin conditions. The bioactive constituents of Habenaria ciliaris var. holopetala include flavonoids, terpenoids, and alkaloids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
